## About
High Society Poker Club is a game room on W Jasper Dr in Killeen. We have standing casino-style machines with a mix of games on each one, plus mouse-and-monitor online computer games.
Regulars can join our VIP rewards system, and one reviewer mentioned potlucks, specials and extra games, especially on weekends. We're rated 4.3 on Google from 185 reviews.

## Services
- Casino-style machines: Standing machines, each with a variety of games to choose from.
- Online computer games: Mouse-and-monitor online computer games.
- VIP rewards: Bonuses for active players.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on Friday?
A: No, we're closed on Friday.

Q: When can I come in the rest of the week?
A: Saturday through Thursday we're open around the clock.

Q: Is there anything special on weekends?
A: One reviewer mentioned frequent potlucks, specials and extra games, especially on weekends.

## What customers say
- "Game room featuring maverick online games, staff is super friendly and business is kept tidy. Frequent pot lucks, specials and extra games especially on the weekends." (ady Hammontree, 5/5)
- "Tina Marie is the best person, as well as the best employee I’ve ever encountered. She is the main reason I continue to come to this Jasper location." (Tristian Ford, 5/5)
- "Still a low-end type game room, but staff is friendlier and more helpful than at their sister store on Stan Schleuter. They have several standing casino-style machines, each with a variety of games to choose from (Raging Bison is my favorite). Not a great parking lot, and the inside is outdated. Besides the tower games, the others are older mouse and monitor online computer games, but still pretty fun. They have a VIP rewards system that throws bonuses for active players. Not the cleanest or most modern facility, but overall, still a good time." (Math-yugh, 4/5)
